scope: User view and client/network activity of DELIVERY-01 and DELIVERY-02

evidence.locator: Dialog title, Extend and Logout controls
early return lines 7-13; loading reset line 48
Axios adapter and Route; DEL-20 timeline and observations

claims.claim: After final diagnostic-request cancellation, candidate retains PageLoader; main clears it. Authentication and error state remain unchanged.
claims.rationale: Matching real Axios and rendered store/DOM observations differ only at the preservation predicate.
claims.limits: Headless Edge direct API fixture; 250ms final check; no production gesture or frequency established.

claims.claim: GET /api/delivery-confidence/slow is browser-intercepted before server dispatch. The fixture never fetches or continues that route.
claims.rationale: Public GET wrapper, /api prefix, and held page.route are directly inspected.
claims.limits: No business endpoint receives this diagnostic request. Server-side work cancellation is not established.

claims.claim: The retained cancellation code is ERR_CANCELED. No Chromium requestfailed text is retained for this diagnostic route.
claims.rationale: The fixture saves the Axios rejection code; it does not save a route-specific Chromium error string.
claims.limits: Do not substitute net::ERR_ABORTED from other probes.

claims.claim: At T+35.001 main acquires replacement refresh; candidate makes no acquisition call. At expiry main has enabled Extend, while candidate starts logout.
claims.rationale: Paired initial values and exact relative checkpoint times are retained.
claims.limits: Controlled coincident expiry and clock; Axios adapter invocations, not live-provider traffic.

claims.claim: Acquisition uses POST /api/auth/v2/sso/refreshtoken. Logout starts POST /api/auth/v2/sso/logout and GET /api/ssiplus/imeta/logout, then clears local auth without waiting for responses.
claims.rationale: Methods come from exact client source; paired execution records corresponding URL lists.
claims.limits: Synthetic immediate HTTP200 adapter; analytics mocked; not a complete browser network trace.

claims.claim: Eligible Extend invokes POST /api/auth/v2/sso/relogin. Actual routing selects Login after auth clears.
claims.rationale: Exact Extend handler and RoutingComponent predicates are inspected.
claims.limits: DEL-20 never clicks Extend and renders a lightweight Signed out test route. Neither complete user journey was executed here.

claims.claim: The candidate may briefly show the expiry dialog during logout. It removes the user recovery opportunity in the controlled state.
claims.confidence: MODERATE for visible transient; HIGH for controlled loss of recovery
claims.rationale: Source mounts the dialog and starts delayed logout; retained state confirms no enabled Extend and final signout.
claims.limits: No retained atExpiry dialog-presence assertion or measured visible duration. extendEnabled=false can also mean button absent.

claims.claim: Natural trigger frequency, production user gestures, and exact deployed screen/network outcomes remain unestablished.
claims.confidence: HIGH for the stated evidence limit
claims.rationale: The retained records declare their fixture and deployment limits.
claims.limits: Owner unknown; requires authorized deployed-source and observation evidence before a production-specific claim.

limitations: Automated checks do not check the complete approved dictionary or grammar rules.
